scope: All 12 public task definitions in the pinned release; 100 advertised full-suite tasks. Agentic provisional ID.
assessment_scope: Every public question and metadata record manually assessed. Input schemas, biological fixtures, execution and actual scorer behavior remain uninspected. Scorer type names are metadata only. Expected-answer configuration was omitted from the saved metadata projection and was not read for authoring.

inventory_completeness.discrepancy: README says seven examples; manifest and nontruncated tree agree on the recorded count. No IDs invented for the unavailable full-suite remainder.

license_and_contamination: No root license file in the pinned tree; public metadata is paraphrased for coverage research. This is not permission to redistribute experimental data.

task_defaults.assessment: public-prompt-pattern-assessed; inputs and executable scoring uninspected
remaining_gaps: Select independent observed biological data and check source lineage and reuse terms; benchmark prompts, answers, trajectories and fixtures are excluded from the training corpus.
Specify quantitative intermediate artifacts, full output populations and decision criteria that can be verified without an LLM judge.
Implement and run a connected private oracle with negative controls and an offline task budget of at most 30 minutes.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Reconcile intervention assays into an evidence-supported mechanism ordering
required_stages: join assay, treatment and readout identities
compare interventions and controls across assays
distinguish supported mechanism links from alternative explanations
export an ordered mechanism and unsupported alternatives
scientific_decisions: A deterministic label grader does not establish causality. An independent task needs explicit evidence-to-claim rules and checks on the quantitative assay artifacts.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Test a compound-response biomarker while controlling lineage and broad activity
required_stages: join compounds, molecular features, cell lines and dose-response outcomes
apply the specified chemical and indication population
estimate response associations and adjust for lineage
calculate a broad-activity negative control
required_formats: compound, cell-line and response tables (encodings uninspected)
scientific_decisions: Preserve the direction of response AUC; predefine the association statistic, covariates, missingness and multiple-testing policy. An adjusted association alone is not causal evidence.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Select selective screening hits with usable coverage and limited broad toxicity
required_stages: identify the common screening dose and eligible compounds
measure activity, panel coverage and broad toxicity
apply an explicit multi-criterion ranking
export distinct compound identifiers and selection count
required_formats: pooled viability and compound tables (encodings uninspected)
scientific_decisions: The public question leaves parts of the ranking rule implicit. A judge-free adaptation needs an explicit rule, tie policy and compound-level evidence table.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Compare target-activity associations with chemical-substructure safety signals
required_stages: join compound identities, concern labels and target mappings
aggregate concentration-specific target predictions
match SMARTS and compute supported-rule enrichment
compare ranked representations with bounded mechanistic conclusions
scientific_decisions: Predicted target activity is model-derived evidence, not an observed binding assay. Define the effect-size statistic and chemical exclusions; convergent association does not establish human causation.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Evaluate target expression prevalence and compartment specificity across patients
required_stages: join raw expression, cell compartments, patients and target identifiers
measure within-compartment expression prevalence
aggregate specificity using patient-aware comparisons
report ranked targets with population sizes
required_formats: raw single-cell counts and metadata (encodings uninspected)
scientific_decisions: Cells are nested within patients. Enrichment and absolute prevalence answer different questions; an adaptation needs a defined specificity score and zero-count behavior.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Reconcile calcium-response perturbations and oscillation changes
required_stages: identify intervention, control and assay conditions
summarize response and oscillating-cell fractions
compare perturbations that distinguish response modes
export the supported response category and direction
scientific_decisions: Mean amplitude and fraction of oscillating cells are distinct endpoints. State mechanistic decision rules and preserve replicate units; do not infer an unmeasured pathway from a category name.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Classify replicated dependency associations using effect direction and driver role
required_stages: join dependency effects, alteration indicators, lineage and driver roles
verify marker-positive effect directions within relevant populations
reconcile gene-level evidence across associations
export disjoint mechanism groups
required_formats: dependency, mutation, copy-number and annotation tables (encodings uninspected)
scientific_decisions: Define how mixed evidence selects one gene-level class. Dependency sign and oncogene/tumor-suppressor annotation do not by themselves prove a mechanistic interaction.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Estimate a plate-position effect against a matched permutation null
required_stages: join morphological profiles with compounds, plates and well coordinates
define eligible treatment-profile pairs and compute correlations
permute positions within a prespecified exchangeable design
subtract the matched null and report its uncertainty
required_formats: morphological feature matrix and plate metadata (encodings uninspected)
scientific_decisions: Compound and plate identities affect exchangeability; do not treat all well pairs as independent. Fix permutation count/seed or use exact expectations and grade complete summaries.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Compute target engagement while distinguishing separate control purposes
required_stages: parse engagement measurements with consistent concentration units
derive occupancy under an explicit dose-response model
apply the stated response threshold
assess the separate control without silently redefining the target population
scientific_decisions: The response model, assay validity rules and role of each control must be explicit. A general control outcome is not automatically an exclusion criterion for another treatment.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Combine tumor activity and healthy-context safety in a matched imaging assay
required_stages: identify treatment, tissue context and imaging channels
quantify the relevant activity and injury phenotypes
compare matched controls within each context
apply a joint advancement rule
scientific_decisions: Image-level choice labels need independently checkable segmentation and quantitative phenotype references. One favorable panel does not establish both activity and safety.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Measure organoid response relative to vehicle and residual viable population
required_stages: identify vehicle replicates and ordered dose images
quantify viable organoid response with a defined image contract
normalize to the vehicle reference
report the first threshold crossing and residual high-dose response
scientific_decisions: A discrete dose index is not a fitted concentration IC50. Specify viability measurement, normalization and uncertainty; a visually persistent object alone is not proven viable resistance.

tasks.workflow_pattern: Integrate efficacy, mechanism images, safety and free exposure into a program decision
required_stages: join compound identities across all four assays
quantify screen response and mechanism phenotype
calculate safety and unbound exposure margins in consistent units
apply a prespecified joint decision and retain the no-candidate outcome
scientific_decisions: The source marks this package synthetic_biology_calibrated. Do not copy its observations into the real-data release; use independent observed assays and make exposure/mechanism rules executable.
tasks.source_input_origin: synthetic_biology_calibrated; metadata claim, inputs not retrieved
